provenance.generator: integration/build_patient.py (M2C Indian-conditioned generation, indian_random_seed=71962); demographics.age/state/urban_rural and risk_factors.* sampled from configs/indian_population.yaml (docs/DECISIONS.md D006); demographics.sex sampled from its Census-2011-derived national marginal; height_cm/weight_kg not modeled (out of M2C scope); ECG is metadata-only, no waveform attached (D003); family_history intentionally left unpopulated — no Indian evidence source (D004); lipid_panel TC/TG/HDL sampled (category-then-uniform, INDIAB-17), LDL DERIVED via Friedewald (never independently sampled, D011); lipid_interpretations COMPUTED per definition, never sampled (D011); labs.HbA1c generated only for non-diabetic patients, age+sex-conditioned (ICMR-INDIAB-12), conditional on the diabetes label above, never the reverse (M4-0B) — see docs/M4B_GENERATION_DESIGN.md; diagnoses are a 1:1 promotion of the hypertension/diabetes risk_factors flags, never independently sampled, diagnosed_date left null (no evidence-backed per-patient onset distribution exists); hyperlipidemia diagnosis deliberately deferred (D015); medical_history chronic_condition entries reference those diagnoses, not re-derived — see docs/M4D_DIAGNOSIS_HISTORY_DESIGN.md; medications generated only for hypertension/diabetes diagnoses, gated on ICMR-NNMS national treatment-rate Bernoulli draws (14.5%/36.1%), drug_class only (antihypertensive/antidiabetic), never a specific drug name; statin/antiplatelet medications not generated (no population treatment-rate evidence); start_date/stop_date left null (no per-patient initiation-date evidence exists), current_status always "active" (D016) — see docs/M4E_MEDICATION_DESIGN.md
